profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a full-stack software developer with a background in math education. I have a passion for learning new technologies, creating intuitive and responsive user experiences, data analysis and visualization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front End Engineer on Remarketing Team, working on modernization efforts for asset management. 

- Modernized a legacy asset management system with React, enabling asset managers to view, edit, and publish asset details, including photos and listing information, on the customer-facing site.

- Developed in-browser photo management tools with upload, tagging, cropping, and brightness/contrast controls.

- Utilized Progressive Web App capabilities for offline data entry and photo uploads, ensuring  background synchronization upon reconnection.

- Established a comprehensive testing framework with Jest, MSW, and Storybook
positions.insights: Skills: React · Redux · TypeScript · Web Engineering · Agile Web Development
